scope: Distinct content and active-state variants for identified source tabs. No live data or invented measurement.

presets.heading: English source review
presets.summary: The source content is reviewed. This does not mean the provider approved the template or that sending is enabled.

presets.heading: Shona locale review
presets.summary: No approved Shona translation is supplied. Keep the target locale disabled until qualified review; do not invent translated content.

presets.heading: Fallback remains explicit
presets.summary: Fallback is a separate policy choice. It does not approve the target translation or bypass provider, consent or publication checks.

presets.heading: Unknown notification operations
presets.summary: Receipt missing. Poll or reconcile the original durable operation; do not create a second send. A reconciliation can remain unknown.

presets.heading: Throttled notification operations
presets.summary: Explicit throttling permits only the documented bounded retry after the wait. Recheck consent before any new send.

presets.heading: Rejected notification operations
presets.summary: The provider rejected an unapproved template. Fix configuration and language/provider approval before resend.

presets.heading: Reserved reward state
presets.summary: Only confirmed reservation credits escrow. Settlement remains blocked while the hold/dispute is unresolved; reservation never gates property recovery.

presets.heading: Declined reward state
presets.summary: Reservation was declined. No escrow funds are credited. Returning to terms must not silently send another payment.

presets.heading: Unknown reward state
presets.summary: No unconfirmed funds are credited. Reconcile the same operation before considering another send; unknown is not declined or confirmed.

presets.heading: Ranking evidence
presets.summary: No validated run is selected. The preset shows the diagnostic and population definition, not a measured ranking score or production accuracy.

presets.heading: Evidence coverage
presets.summary: Coverage includes eligible unavailable inputs separately. Missing evidence is unavailable, not automatic mismatch; no measured percentage is supplied.

presets.heading: Calibration evidence
presets.summary: Calibration is not approved. A target-population holdout and independent approval are required; raw similarity is not ownership confidence.

presets.heading: Recovery report definitions
presets.summary: Defined eligible cohort; confirmed returns and elapsed times remain separate from censored or unknown outcomes. No production result values supplied.

presets.heading: Loss patterns report definitions
presets.summary: Reported observations grouped by broad place, time and category. No private precise locations or ownership inference.

presets.heading: Storage report definitions
presets.summary: Current custody and retention scope define backlog, age and unclaimed inventory. No measured counts supplied.

presets.heading: Trust report definitions
presets.summary: This view separates the fraud-review portion of the source Trust / network row. Independent outcome labels are required; no measured fraud rate supplied.

presets.heading: Network report definitions
presets.summary: This view separates the federation-contribution portion of the source Trust / network row. Peer attribution is retained; independent peer scores are not comparable.

presets.heading: Logistics report definitions
rows: Permitted operation counts; no private money data
presets.summary: Courier and reward usage counts retain operation scope and exclude private money/contact details. No measured usage counts supplied.

presets.heading: Visible candidate samples
presets.summary: These are the two visible cards in the original sample screen, not an exhaustive candidate count. A possible match still requires a private ownership check.

presets.heading: Nearby ordering unavailable
presets.summary: The source design supplies broad Harare locations but no permitted exact distance evidence. Do not invent metres, proximity order or a mismatch; return to All matches for available candidates.

presets.heading: Newest published observations
presets.summary: Ordered only by the two displayed observation dates, 26 Nov then 25 Nov. This does not establish exact observation time or ownership.

M05.evidence: Labels and two visible candidate cards observed in the parent chat live viewer; canonical inventory/register supplies source board provenance.

D02.status: Exact filter labels and rows are not recorded in repository source documents.
D02.required: Use observed native source control labels/rows; do not invent statuses or counts.

rules: Each tab changes active appearance and renders its own heading/content; returning to a tab restores that preset.
An unavailable ordering or diagnostic is explicit; do not fabricate a value to populate an empty chart.
Source content/language readiness is distinct from provider approval and publication.
Navigation targets are review paths, not automated successful operational effects.
